outcome: Quality of life (general, physical, social, psychological, environmental domains)
cohort: The study included 75 women who underwent peripartum hysterectomy and 75 women who had a cesarean delivery as controls, from a single center in South India, identified between July 2016 and June 2021.
finding: Women who underwent peripartum hysterectomy experienced significantly lower overall quality of life and psychological health compared to women who had a cesarean delivery.
